title: POST accounts/:id/orders
summary: Allows to (re)place an order against a certain account.

cells: Account number against which order is being submitted. Can occur in the 'Location' header only.
Optional – order id of the order to be replaced.
Identifies whether the all-or-none instruction is enabled.
Identifies whether the anonymous instruction is enabled.
Order type (e.g., "Market"). See [Order Type](/api/documentation/rest-operations/enumerations/enumerations#order-type) section for all allowed values.
Order side (e.g., "Buy"). See [Order Action](/api/documentation/rest-operations/enumerations/enumerations#order-action) section for all allowed values.
